subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When a frozen task crosses planning, projection, tracker, claim, implementation, or review boundaries, the system shall preserve its assessment, assessment-evidence citations, derived profile, policy version, and planner-raise evidence without reinterpretation.
rationale: current tracker reads lose routing data, and uncoupled evidence would make the judgment unauditable
fit_criterion: boundary round-trip fixtures are field-identical for every supported tracker path, including every evidence reference
